snippet.title: They Fired Every Weapon at Him. He Never Opened His Eyes 🌸
snippet.description:
A whole demon army fires every weapon it has at one man sitting under a tree. Every arrow turns into a flower. Then the demon king tries his last weapon, and one tiny move ends the war.
The Buddhist story of the night before the Buddha's awakening, and why so many Buddha statues reach down to touch the earth.

When a voice tells you that you don't deserve your seat, what do you do? Tell me in the comments.

Retold from the Nidanakatha (the introduction to the Jataka tales) and the Padhana Sutta (Sutta Nipata 3.2). Our own telling: he keeps silent with his eyes shut all night (in the Nidanakatha he answers Mara), the whole attack happens at night, doubt as the "last weapon" (it is one of Mara's armies in the Padhana Sutta), the daughters dancing that night (as in later tellings), and the padlock, the pilgrim and Mara heaving at the seat.

snippet.title: 小谷城で母お市と3人の妹は生き延びたのに、浅井長政の10歳の嫡男・万福丸はその後どうなったのか？
snippet.description:
1573年（天正元年）の小谷城落城のとき、浅井長政は妻のお市と3人の娘（茶々・初・江の浅井三姉妹）を城から送り出し、織田信長の妹であるお市と3人の娘は織田家に引き取られて生き延びました。このとき、浅井長政の10歳の嫡男・万福丸も家臣を付けられて小谷城から城外へ逃がされました。共に城から出られたのなら万福丸もどこか遠くでひっそり生き延びられたように見えますが、3年にわたり信長と戦った長政の家を継ぐ10歳の嫡男・万福丸は、信長に探し出されて関ヶ原で処刑され、浅井氏の嫡流は断絶したと考えられてきました。落城前の脱出から越前国敦賀郡での潜伏・羽柴秀吉への引き渡しと伝わる最期、そして浅井家の菩提寺とされる滋賀県長浜市の徳勝寺に今も残る父・浅井長政の墓所まで、史料と伝承に基づいてたどります。

snippet.title: Timeline That Brought Cyclops Back To Life For Avengers: Doomsday
snippet.description:
The final Avengers: Doomsday trailer dropped on November 23, 2026. One shot broke the internet. James Marsden's Cyclops is back. He says the iconic "To me, my X-Men!" line. But wait. Didn't Cyclops die in X-Men: The Last Stand (2006)? Here is the complete theory for how Cyclops is alive and fighting alongside the Avengers in Doomsday.

This is a fan theory, not official MCU canon.

The Death: X-Men: The Last Stand (2006)

In X-Men: The Last Stand, directed by Brett Ratner, Scott Summers (Cyclops) is grieving the death of Jean Grey at Alkali Lake (where she sacrificed herself in X2). He hears her voice calling him.

Scott travels to Alkali Lake alone. Jean appears to him. She is alive, but she is no longer the Jean he knew. She is the Phoenix.

Scott tries to reach her. The Phoenix disintegrates him. Off-screen. In the opening 15 minutes of the film.

Cyclops, one of the most iconic X-Men in comic history, was killed off-screen in the first act of a movie. Fans were furious. James Marsden barely appeared.

For 10 years, Cyclops stayed dead in the Fox X-Men timeline.

The Time Travel: X-Men: Days of Future Past (2014)

In 2014, Bryan Singer directed X-Men: Days of Future Past, the time-travel epic that rewrote the entire Fox X-Men franchise.

In a dark future 2023, Sentinels have exterminated mutants and most of humanity. The surviving X-Men (Professor X, Magneto, Wolverine, Storm, Kitty Pryde, and others) devise a plan. Kitty uses her powers to send Wolverine's consciousness back to 1973.

Wolverine's mission: stop Mystique from killing Bolivar Trask. Her assassination of Trask is what triggers the Sentinel program. Preventing it will prevent the dystopian future.

Wolverine succeeds. In 1973, Mystique spares Trask's life. The Sentinel program never launches. The X-Men's future is rewritten.

The Reset Timeline

At the end of Days of Future Past, Wolverine wakes up in 2023. But not his 2023. A NEW 2023.

He walks through Charles Xavier's School for Gifted Youngsters. The hallways are bright. Students are laughing. The war is gone.

He walks past Jean Grey, who is alive.

He walks past Scott Summers (Cyclops), who is alive. James Marsden made an uncredited cameo for this scene.

He walks into Professor X's office. Charles (Patrick Stewart) is alive. Beast is alive. The X-Men are the X-Men again.

The events of X-Men (2000), X2 (2003), and X-Men: The Last Stand (2006) have been erased from the timeline. None of those events happened.

In the reset timeline:
Jean Grey never became the Phoenix.
Cyclops never died at Alkali Lake.
Rogue never lost her powers.
Professor X never died.

Earth-10005 Confirmed

The Fox X-Men universe was officially designated Earth-10005 by Marvel Studios after Deadpool & Wolverine (2024). This is the canonical designation for all the Fox X-Men films, both pre and post Days of Future Past.

In Deadpool & Wolverine, Earth-10005 was established as a dying universe because its Anchor Being (Hugh Jackman's Wolverine) died in Logan (2017).

But before Logan's events, the DOFP reset timeline was still in effect. Cyclops was still alive. Jean was still alive. The X-Men were still a team.

The Final Doomsday Trailer: Cyclops Returns

The November 23, 2026 Doomsday trailer shows the X-Men teaming up with the Avengers against Sentinels inside the X-Mansion.

James Marsden's Cyclops delivers the line: "To me, my X-Men!"

This is the most iconic Cyclops line in all of Marvel Comics. It is the leader's rallying cry. The line Chris Claremont made famous in the 1980s.

Marsden's delivery confirms that this is the Days of Future Past reset Cyclops. The one who never died at Alkali Lake. The one who grew into the team leader he was always meant to be.

Why This Cyclops Matters

The Doomsday Cyclops is the version of the character Fox fans always wanted. The leader. The commander. The man who actually gets to fight alongside Wolverine, Storm, and the rest of the X-Men as equals.

James Marsden was never given a full arc in the original Fox trilogy. Cyclops was sidelined for Wolverine in every film. This return is Marsden's redemption. Marvel giving him the character moment he was denied 20 years ago.

snippet.description:
The U.S. Army detonated nearly five tons of degraded explosives at the Iowa Army Ammunition Plant in Middletown, Iowa, at 9 a.m. Wednesday. The Army said the time could change as officials monitor weather conditions.

This comes after the Army discovered that 68 barrels of lead azide became unstable in March.The stockpile of explosives was brought to the plant in 2009, according to Robert Cekada, director of the Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, Firearms and Explosives. 

The chemicals, used in munitions production, were stored in barrels in case the military needed to use them again.

During a briefing on Tuesday, federal officials reiterated that a controlled detonation is the only safe option for Middletown and the surrounding area.

snippet.title: Güller ve Günahlar 124. Kısa Bölüm
snippet.description:
Dürüstlük, aile bağları ve güven üzerine kurduğu hayatıyla tanınan başarılı iş insanı Serhat, eşi Berrak’ın yıllardır sakladığı büyük bir gerçeği öğrenince sarsılır. Berrak’ın geçirdiği talihsiz kaza sonrası komaya girmesi, Serhat’ı yanıtlarını bulmak için zorlu bir yolculuğa çıkarır. Bu süreçte, yoksul bir mahallenin cesur ve açık sözlü kızı Zeynep ile yolları kesişir. Farklı dünyalara ait Serhat ve Zeynep, ihanet, aşk ve gizli sırların gölgesinde aynı fırtınaya kapılır. Kalplerinin çağrısına karşı koymaya çalışsalar da, geçmişin karanlık yüzü onları geri dönüşü olmayan bir yola sürükler.  

Güller ve Günahlar’da Murat Yıldırım başarılı iş insanı Serhat karakteri ile Cemre Baysel ise fakir mahallenin cesur ve dobra kızı Zeynep rolüyle izleyici karşısına çıkmaya hazırlanıyor. İkiliye önemli rollerde Oya Unustası, Gülenay Kalkan, Serdar Orçin, Emel Çölgecen, Ahmet Saraçoğlu, Aleyna Solaker, Kaan Çakır, Serdar Özer, Gizem Sevim, Neslihan Arslan, Emre Özcan, Merve Su Bengi ve Mina Akdin gibi yıldızlar kadrosu eşlik ediyor. Dizinin sevimli yıldızlarına ise Beren Gençalp ve Yade Arayıcı hayat veriyor.
Deniz Can Çelik yönetmenliğinde ekrana gelecek olan Güller ve Günahlar, hayatını dürüstlük, aile sevgisi ve güven üzerine kuran Serhat’ın (Murat Yıldırım), eşi Berrak’ın yıllardır sakladığı büyük bir sırrı öğrenmesiyle alt üst olan hayatına odaklanıyor. Serhat’ın yolu, dobra ve cesur tavırlarıyla dikkat çeken Zeynep’le (Cemre Baysel) kesiştiğinde ikili kendilerini büyük bir fırtınanın içinde buluyor.

About Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah:
--------------------------------------------------------------------
The show is inspired from the famous humorous column 'Duniya Ne Undha Chasma' written by the eminent Gujarati writer Mr. Tarak Mehta. This story revolves around daily happenings in "Gokuldham Co-operative Society" and covers topical issues which are socially relevant. The show predominantly - revolves around 'Jethalal' who is an uneducated Gujarati businessman. Your 'Taarak Mehta', is his neighbor. 'Jethalal' finds a friend and philosopher in 'Taarak Mehta' and often goes to him for advice whenever he is in trouble. Jethalaal's family includes his simpleton wife 'Daya Ben' and a mischievous son 'Tapu'. Tapu is a menace and a constant source of trouble to all the members of Gokuldham. They have often warned 'Jethalal' to reform 'Tapu' or else be prepared to leave the premises. Lost hopes of being heard by his son push Jethalal' to call his father 'Champaklal' from the village. This was his great idea of leashing some control over the mischievous Tapu. The opposite happens and the grandfather joins hands with the grandson to make life a roller coaster troublesome ride for Jethalal.

snippet.description:
‘কথা’ ইউটিউব চ্যানেলে আপনাকে স্বাগতম।

snippet.description:
KDF 15 - Ex-Wife and Her Fiancé Mocked His Rusty Truck—Unaware He Owned the Bank

His ex-wife mocked his rusty truck in front of the entire bank, calling him a broke loser. Seven years after leaving him, she still believed he was nothing more than a poor mechanic's son. But she had no idea that the man she humiliated was now the bank's new owner.

When Nathan Brooks arrives in his late father's rusty truck, his arrogant ex-wife Danielle and her wealthy fiancé publicly humiliate him. But while they laugh at his appearance, a kind bank teller named Grace treats him with dignity and respect.

As Nathan keeps his identity a secret, he uncovers a shocking $3 million scheme threatening the savings of 250 elderly customers. What happens when the truth finally comes out?

A powerful emotional drama about betrayal, family legacy, kindness, hidden wealth, karma, and justice. A reminder that you should never judge someone's worth by what they drive or wear.
